scene_description: A family of four — one adult and three children — sit on camping chairs around a fire pit in a wooded area. A green tent is visible in the background. The children appear to be roasting marshmallows over the fire.

questions.question: What is in the middle of the group?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the round metal bowl in front of everyone.

questions.question: Who is sitting in the chairs?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at all the people sitting around the fire.

questions.question: What is set up behind the people?
questions.evidence_hint: Look behind the people in the background.

questions.question: Where are the people sitting?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the tall trees all around them.

questions.question: What are the children holding toward the fire?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at what the children are pointing at the fire.
